Subject: Discovery: Atlas Health - Redwood inference fit / next steps

Samir — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps.

Key takeaways from the call:
- Current infra: Atlas runs models in a mixed cloud setup; peak inference latency around 300–500ms for critical routes.
- Primary pain: unpredictable p99 latency and rising per-token inference cost; want predictable throughput for scheduled batches and lower cost for high-volume routes.
- Success criteria: p95 < 150ms on <1s tail for core routes, predictable monthly cost within budget, ability to pin models and audit logs for compliance.

What Redwood can offer (high level):
- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools) for predictable throughput and isolation
- Autoscaling + smart routing to keep critical routes under SLOs while lowering unit cost for background work
- Observability + token-level cost breakdown so you can measure impact of batching/quantization

Proposed next steps:
1) Share a tailored 2–3 page pilot proposal (I attached our Dedicated overview) — I will send a short pilot draft by EOD tomorrow.
2) 30-minute technical follow-up with your infra lead to scope resource needs — suggested slots next week.
3) If the pilot looks good, coordinate procurement and timeline (we typically do a 3-week PoC for customers with a similar profile).

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Overview.pdf (PDF, 2.4MB)

Can you confirm: (a) priority for this initiative at Atlas (high / medium / low), and (b) who should join the technical follow-up (name + email)?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
